title: Mixing: Wings Over The World by Wings | 1978
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

The first mixing session for the Wings Over The World documentary took place on 30 October 1978.

This was the first of five sessions for the project, with the others taking place in November. The songs mixed on this day were performances of ‘The Long And Winding Road’, ‘You Gave Me The Answer’, ‘Live And Let Die’, and ‘Letting Go’.
